title: Four Into One
summary: A paper act whose FIG. 03 draws each reading as a flat square whose area is its value, one per 100-unit frame beside its 168px numeral, then merges the four frames into one so the squares nest on a single corner: 'four numbers, one diagnosis' happens on screen, with the data intact, instead of sitting in four identical dials.

reference.borrowed: A data plate with no axes where nesting is the chart: flat squares whose areas are the values, anchored in one shared bottom-left corner, each carrying its own value set inside its top-right corner ('91%', '54%'), the larger one dark and the smaller one in a second flat tone, under a one-line title and a hairline, with a small source line.
reference.kelwin: The reference's single nest becomes the act's argument, switched by A's Plurel-style segmented control. Readings: four 2-column frames tile the centre crossing of a 2×2 hairline grid of 168px numerals, each holding its reading as a bottom-left square (area = value), so the hairline cross runs through the figure's own gutters. Diagnosis: the four frames merge into one 4-column frame and the squares nest on its corner, largest at the back. Nested, the visible bands are the Kelwin mark's right angles stepping down-left, drawn by the data rather than copied from the logo (ink 95, fog 77, blush 53). The only red element is the 17% core, the share of the journey sales actually owns. The 2.5% sliver between the 95 square and the frame is the '5' of 95:5.

motion: entrance: label fades (300ms); 'Four numbers.' then the light 'One diagnosis.' rise out of masks (800ms); the 48×2 red rule draws and the lede fades up 12px; the plate's top rule, centre hairline and vertical draw from their origins (900ms); readings fade up in reading order; the four numerals count up once from 00 (1.2s, tabular), the ':5' of 95:5 landing with its count

entrance: the four 100-unit frames fade in, then each reading grows out of its frame's bottom-left corner to its area (95, 77, 53: 700ms, 120ms apart); the red 17 lands last (400ms), then the in-area values appear

state change at 2.4s: the control switches Readings → Diagnosis; over 900ms --ease-inout (95 first, 17 last, 70ms apart) the squares travel and rescale from their own frames onto the one shared frame's corner and nest; the four frames give way to the single frame and the crossing clears under the figure
interaction: the Readings | Diagnosis control really toggles both states (900ms each way); hovering a reading firms up its frame in the Readings state
on the live site: the plate advances to Diagnosis once when it is 50% visible; reduced motion shows the final Diagnosis state with all numerals at value
notes: Coherence pass: the head moved from Plurel's split (lede in cols 9–12) to the hero's stack (statement → red rule → lede below), the label left mono for the Mona caps label, the statement went from 80px/−0.03em to 96px on the display tokens, and the Readings | Diagnosis control is tracked caps like every other A control. To hold the slice under 1400px the numerals are 168px (from 176) and the cells are 8–12px tighter. The 2×2 readings sit in cols 1–4 and 9–12; the figure owns cols 5–8, centred on the crossing. Readings frames are exactly 2 columns + gutter (cols 5–6 / 7–8, 24px apart, so the hairline cross runs through their gutters); the Diagnosis frame is cols 5–8. Areas are honest in both states: side = √value × frame. The nested figure uses the mark's grammar (bottom-left-anchored right angles) at data proportions, so it is never presented or labelled as the logo. The harness shots catch the entrance (mid) and the final Diagnosis state; the Readings state holds from ~1.6s to 2.4s and the control brings it back. Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
